escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Why GTA is a Bigger Deal Than You Think, by Mrwhosetheboss, with over 11 million views.
In second place, Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?, by Mr Spring, with over 19 million views.
And number one: Kevin says Seed is TOO SMALL 🎡, by SEEDPIT Official, with over 28 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
